source_geometry.role: frozen geometry only; not an approved color or production reference

edit_authorization.allowed_scope: reclassify opaque pixels in clusters smaller than a true 2x2 block to the dominant color in their immediate 8-neighbor ring, including material and outline boundaries
strict_invariants: binary transparency and exact alpha geometry
semantic white/yellow/burgundy anchors do not leak

cluster_rule.minimum: component must contain at least one solid 2x2 square
cluster_rule.remapping: dominant adjacent indexed color; transfer material ownership when the winning index belongs to another material; index 1 may absorb boundary pixels as outline
cluster_rule.execution: one component at a time, recompute immediately, repeat to fixed point; stop as failed if unresolved or iteration limit reached

prohibited: blur, antialias, interpolation, color averaging, luminance filters, RGB-distance mapping
ROM compilation before owner visual approval
required_review_artifacts: per-material masks and pixel change log
semantic compliance and independent per-cell cluster audit
explicit note that quantitative pass is not artistic approval

approval.scope: 61-pose art source; runtime integration remains a distinct gate
